responsibility: Provides the GCN backend’s tree/GIMPLE-level OpenACC lowering hooks, centered on target-specific expansion of GOACC reduction internal functions. It builds gang/worker reduction code sequences, including lock-free compare-and-swap loops for 32- and 64-bit updates, lock-based handling for larger objects via a global reduction lock symbol, worker-local reduction buffers in LDS/shared storage, and setup/init/fini/teardown expansion for different partitioning levels; it also implements hooks that retag gang-private decls into LDS address space and create worker broadcast records in shared memory.
